name: table typed with a header row
script: const c = editor.chain().insertTable({ rows: 3, cols: 2, withHeaderRow: true }); for (const t of ['Name', 'Role', 'Sara Khan', 'Sponsor', 'Omar', 'PM']) c.insertContent(t).goToNextCell(); c.run();
why: the insert menu's table, typed cell by cell (Tab to the next cell)

name: table with marks and awkward text in cells
script: const c = editor.chain().insertTable({ rows: 2, cols: 3, withHeaderRow: true }); c.insertContent('Item').goToNextCell().insertContent('Owner').goToNextCell().insertContent('Notes').goToNextCell(); c.insertContent({ type: 'text', text: 'ABC-A-003', marks: [{ type: 'bold' }] }).goToNextCell(); c.insertContent({ type: 'text', text: 'plan', marks: [{ type: 'link', attrs: { href: 'https://example.com/plan' } }] }).goToNextCell(); c.insertContent('Q&A on a | b, weekly_report_v2 and `code` < 8% * maybe').run();
why: bold, a link and text Markdown could misread in a cell; a | must be escaped or the row splits (upstream loses the rest of the cell)

name: table with an empty cell
script: const c = editor.chain().insertTable({ rows: 2, cols: 3, withHeaderRow: true }); for (const t of ['A', 'B', 'C', 'one', '', 'three']) c.insertContent(t || []).goToNextCell(); c.run();
why: a cell left empty keeps its place

name: table with columns and rows added and removed
script: editor.chain().insertTable({ rows: 3, cols: 2, withHeaderRow: true }).insertContent('Name').goToNextCell().insertContent('Role').run(); editor.chain().addColumnAfter().run(); editor.chain().insertContent('Since').goToNextCell().insertContent('Sara').goToNextCell().insertContent('Sponsor').goToNextCell().insertContent('2026').run(); editor.chain().addRowAfter().goToNextCell().insertContent('Omar').goToNextCell().insertContent('PM').goToNextCell().insertContent('2025').run(); editor.chain().goToPreviousCell().goToPreviousCell().goToPreviousCell().goToPreviousCell().deleteRow().run();
why: the table menu's add column, add row and delete row

name: table between paragraphs
script: editor.chain().insertContent('Before the table.').run(); editor.chain().insertContentAt(editor.state.doc.content.size, { type: 'paragraph' }).run(); editor.chain().setTextSelection(editor.state.doc.content.size - 1).insertTable({ rows: 2, cols: 2, withHeaderRow: true }).insertContent('x').goToNextCell().insertContent('y').goToNextCell().insertContent('1').goToNextCell().insertContent('2').run(); editor.chain().insertContentAt(editor.state.doc.content.size, { type: 'paragraph', content: [{ type: 'text', text: 'After the table.' }] }).run();
why: a table inserted in the middle of a note, with an empty line left after it

name: table with a line break in a cell
script: editor.chain().insertTable({ rows: 2, cols: 2, withHeaderRow: true }).insertContent('Step').goToNextCell().insertContent('Detail').goToNextCell().insertContent('One').goToNextCell().insertContent('first line').setHardBreak().insertContent('second line').run();
why:
Shift+Enter in a cell: a table row is one line, so the break is
there (it reads back as a hard break)

name: table pasted as HTML
why: a table pasted from a web page or Word

name: table with no header row
script: const c = editor.chain().insertTable({ rows: 2, cols: 2, withHeaderRow: false }); for (const t of ['a', 'b', 'c', 'd']) c.insertContent(t).goToNextCell(); c.run();
why: known loss: a Markdown table always has a header row, so the first row comes back as headers. Stable, and the writer says so (faithful: false); the Notes insert menu always makes a header row

name: checklist typed, one ticked
why: the insert menu's checklist: Enter for the next item, a box ticked

name: checklist nested
script: editor.chain().insertContent('Prepare the steering pack').toggleTaskList().splitListItem('taskItem').insertContent('Health and risks').sinkListItem('taskItem').splitListItem('taskItem').insertContent('Milestones').run(); editor.commands.updateAttributes('taskItem', { checked: true }); editor.chain().splitListItem('taskItem').liftListItem('taskItem').insertContent('Send it').run();
contains:
- [ ] Health and risks
  - [x] Milestones
- [ ] Send it
why: Tab and Shift+Tab in a checklist; nested items 2 spaces in (creaite's style)

name: checklist with marks, links, item IDs and mentions
script: editor.chain().toggleTaskList().insertContent([{ type: 'text', text: 'Chase ' }, { type: 'text', text: 'ABC-A-003', marks: [{ type: 'bold' }] }, { type: 'text', text: ' with @Sara Khan, see ' }, { type: 'text', text: 'the plan', marks: [{ type: 'link', attrs: { href: 'https://example.com/plan' } }] }]).splitListItem('taskItem').insertContent('Q&A on #3 and weekly_report_v2 * maybe').splitListItem('taskItem').insertContent([{ type: 'text', text: 'provisional', marks: [{ type: 'italic' }] }, { type: 'text', text: ' date' }]).run();
why: what a Working session note's actions look like; text written as it is, not escaped

name: checklist ticked, unticked and ticked again
script: editor.chain().insertContent('One').toggleTaskList().splitListItem('taskItem').insertContent('Two').run(); for (const v of [true, false, true]) editor.commands.updateAttributes('taskItem', { checked: v });

name: checklist then an empty line, a bullet list and a paragraph
script: editor.chain().insertContent('Task').toggleTaskList().run(); editor.commands.insertContentAt(editor.state.doc.content.size, [{ type: 'bulletList', content: [{ type: 'listItem', content: [{ type: 'paragraph', content: [{ type: 'text', text: 'A bullet' }] }] }] }, { type: 'paragraph', content: [{ type: 'text', text: 'A paragraph.' }] }]);
why: an empty paragraph straight after a list can't be written (the list takes in blank lines): the writer leaves it out, so the first save is already stable

name: two checklists with a paragraph between
script: editor.chain().insertContent('First').toggleTaskList().run(); editor.commands.insertContentAt(editor.state.doc.content.size, [{ type: 'paragraph', content: [{ type: 'text', text: 'Between.' }] }, { type: 'taskList', content: [{ type: 'taskItem', attrs: { checked: true }, content: [{ type: 'paragraph', content: [{ type: 'text', text: 'Second' }] }] }] }]);
why: two checklists apart, the editor's trailing empty paragraph between them

name: checklist then a numbered list
script: editor.chain().insertContent('Re-plan UAT').toggleTaskList().run(); editor.commands.insertContentAt(editor.state.doc.content.size - 2, { type: 'orderedList', content: [{ type: 'listItem', content: [{ type: 'paragraph', content: [{ type: 'text', text: 'Escalate' }] }] }, { type: 'listItem', content: [{ type: 'paragraph', content: [{ type: 'text', text: 'Agree dates' }] }] }] });
why: a checklist and a numbered list side by side

name: note with a heading, a table and a checklist
script: editor.chain().setNode('heading', { level: 3 }).insertContent('Working session').run(); editor.commands.insertContentAt(editor.state.doc.content.size, [{ type: 'paragraph', content: [{ type: 'text', text: 'With Sara and Omar.' }] }, { type: 'table', content: [{ type: 'tableRow', content: [{ type: 'tableHeader', content: [{ type: 'paragraph', content: [{ type: 'text', text: 'Topic' }] }] }, { type: 'tableHeader', content: [{ type: 'paragraph', content: [{ type: 'text', text: 'Outcome' }] }] }] }, { type: 'tableRow', content: [{ type: 'tableCell', content: [{ type: 'paragraph', content: [{ type: 'text', text: 'Budget' }] }] }, { type: 'tableCell', content: [{ type: 'paragraph', content: [{ type: 'text', text: 'Agreed' }] }] }] }] }, { type: 'taskList', content: [{ type: 'taskItem', attrs: { checked: false }, content: [{ type: 'paragraph', content: [{ type: 'text', text: 'Send minutes' }] }] }] }]);
why: the Working session template's shape: a heading, a table and actions

name: report text section: heading, code block, checklist, picture and a link (#218)
script: editor.commands.setContent([{ type: 'heading', attrs: { level: 2 }, content: [{ type: 'text', text: 'Plan' }] }, { type: 'codeBlock', content: [{ type: 'text', text: 'a = 1\nb = 2' }] }, { type: 'taskList', content: [{ type: 'taskItem', attrs: { checked: true }, content: [{ type: 'paragraph', content: [{ type: 'text', text: 'done' }] }] }, { type: 'taskItem', attrs: { checked: false }, content: [{ type: 'paragraph', content: [{ type: 'text', text: 'open', marks: [{ type: 'link', attrs: { href: 'https://example.com/a' } }] }] }] }] }, { type: 'image', attrs: { src: '_images/2026-10-18-x.png', alt: 'cap' } }]);
why: H5: what the report text section's bar and Insert menu make (heading, code block, checklist, a link, a picture) is written the same way twice more
